content.text:
Netflix (NASDAQ: **NFLX**) has no true public pure-play peer at comparable scale. Its closest public competitors are:

| Company | Ticker | Competitive overlap |
|---|---:|---|
| The Walt Disney Company | **DIS** | Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+; closest diversified streaming peer |
| Warner Bros. Discovery | **WBD** | Max and Discovery+; premium film and television |
| Comcast | **CMCSA** | Peacock and NBCUniversal content |
| Paramount | **PARA** | Paramount+ and Pluto TV |
| Amazon | **AMZN** | Prime Video, MGM Studios, and advertising-supported streaming |
| Apple | **AAPL** | Apple TV+ and original programming |
| Alphabet | **GOOGL** / **GOOG** | YouTube and YouTube TV; major competitor for viewing time and advertising |
| Roku | **ROKU** | Streaming platform, advertising, and The Roku Channel |
| Fox Corporation | **FOXA** / **FOX** | Tubi and sports/news video content |
| Sony Group | **SONY** | Film and television production plus Crunchyroll |

**Best core peer set for NFLX:** **DIS, WBD, CMCSA, PARA, AMZN, and ROKU**.

For a valuation comparison, use caution: Disney, Comcast, Amazon, Apple, and Alphabet are diversified businesses, while Netflix is much closer to a streaming pure play.
